arguments.value: 1984 JLG 60GR aerial lift sold as-is, with extensive rust, weathering, and deterioration from prolonged outdoor storage. This inoperable unit does not run and has non-working hydraulics, with parts possibly missing and repairs likely needed. A great project for parts, salvage, or restoration.
